name: com.mattpyle/steward-audit
title: Steward
description: Audits any website for agent-readiness and returns the report in the same call: robots.txt and its AI-agent rules, Content Signals, the sitemap, llms.txt and whether its links resolve, agents.md, the well-known MCP and A2A discovery documents, and whether the homepage and a content page actually serve markdown when asked for it. Checks behaviour rather than presence, obeys the target's robots.txt, and takes seconds.
